summary: Verified Items bulk-import (CSV+Excel), header aliasing, auto-account create, idempotent re-run, no-name rejection, update_existing=false skip behavior, expense_account_id backfill on Item create/patch, and Bill line ItemPicker that persists expense_account_id/name back to the DB. Backend pytest = 10/10 passing. Frontend Playwright walked the /items Import CSV/Excel modal end-to-end (dropzone, both toggles, submit, result panel with resolved column mapping, Done button), the new Expense-account picker on the New-item modal, the ItemPicker on the /bills New-Bill line row (open menu, pick option, free-form typing), and confirmed the two just-imported items showed up immediately in the bill's ItemPicker.
critical_code_review_comments: items.py import_items: `int(idx) + 2` assumes df.index is a RangeIndex — safe today (we don't set index_col), but if a caller ever uploads a CSV with a first-column index it could mis-report the row number in errors[].

items.py _resolve_account_for_type: auto-created accounts are inserted with `code: None`. accounts.py should already tolerate this, but downstream reports that key off numeric code will show these as un-numbered.

items.py import_items reads the entire file into memory then iterates row-by-row with an `await db.accounts.find_one` per unique account (cached) and per-row `db.items.find_one` — for very large files (>5k rows) this will be slow; consider a bulk name-lookup on the whole set first.
ItemImportModal.jsx: no client-side row-count cap or size guard — a user could POST a 50MB xlsx. Not a bug, but worth a soft limit on the frontend.
Bills.jsx line row: only col-span-5 for the ItemPicker leaves the description text truncated for long item names — cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Backend test builds its own TEST_imp_<hex>_* items, an auto-created revenue+expense account pair, and a Bill; all deleted in test_zzz_cleanup. UI test's two TEST_uiimp_* items + the legacy leftover TEST_item_AAA_baaaa3 (from iter57) were pruned via cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_items_import_and_bills.py -v -o addopts=` — needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (module reads from /app/frontend/.env indirectly, but the test also honours the env var explicitly). Test contract covers data-testids: items-import-btn, item-import-modal/dropzone/file/create-accts/update-existing/submit/result/done, item-expense-account, bill-line-0-open/menu/opt-*/input. GET /api/companies/{cid}/bills/{id} returns 405 (list-only route) — use the list endpoint. Bills accept `vendor_id` field on POST (contact_id also worked as fallback in the retry branch, but wasn't hit).
